Texas Frito Pie
By: Rob
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:41pm

Ingredients




1 package of Fritos
3 Cans of chili without beans
1 Chopped onion
1 package of grated cheddar cheese

Preparation

1 Spray casserole dish with Pam 2 Sprinkle bottom with Fritos 3 Pour chili over the Fritos 4 Sprinkle chopped onions liberally over the the chili 5 Cover with grated cheddar cheese 6 Bake at 350 degrees for about 30 minutes

About


This is one of the family's old favorites. In this day of healthy food, it may not be the best, but it sure is good!
